name: Digital Network SA
summary: Digital Network SA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in media and advertising business in Poland. The company provides digital outdoor advertising and consulting services. It is also involved in the distribution, support, and marketing of thematic TV channels, as well as marketing and promotional activities for customers. The company was formerly known as 4fun Media S.A. and changed its name to Digital Network SA in April 2022. Digital Network SA was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. Digital Network SA operates as a subsidiary of Epicom Ltd.
